marks.gloss_en: isn't this R' Elazar bar Minyumi's: slaughter like a comb is valid
R' Elazar bar Minyumi: slaughter made like a comb is valid
perhaps [he spoke of a comb-like cut] in the place of slaughter -- left standing: the novelty it would then teach is shown (מהו דתימא בעינן שחיטה מפורעת)
perhaps [R' Elazar bar Minyumi spoke of a comb-like cut] within the place of slaughter
rightly he proclaimed 'gentile, gentile': there the life left by the gentile's hand; here he did all the slaughtering -- what difference?
Rava: granted there -- since the Jew should have cut the majority and did not, when the life left it left by the gentile's hand
do not retract, or you ruin the first ruling: there you validated because the life left in the valid cut; here too the life left in the diversion (= p_shs_nafka_behagrama)
Rav Chisda: there, why did you validate? because the life left in the valid cut; here too, the life left in the diversion
what is the difference [between cutting at a perforation and meeting one]? -- R' Elazar's answer (19b.10) is rejected as גוי גוי and Rava endorses the rejection (19b.11)
קרי עליה: גוי גוי
R' Elazar: cutting at a perforation is as if a gentile cut and a Jew finished
if he cut at the place of a perforation? -- valid
if he cut and met a perforation? -- invalid
שכל העורף כשר למליקה -- the mishna's ground for validating pinching from the oref
וכל הצואר כשר לשחיטה -- the mishna's ground for validating slaughter from the throat
one who slaughters from the sides -- his slaughter is valid
כדקתני סיפא: כל העורף כשר למליקה -- the mishna's own later clause uses oref for the place valid for pinching
מאי אריא שוחט? אפילו מולק נמי! ממול ערפו אמר רחמנא ולא ערפו -- at the oref itself pinching too would be invalid, so the mishna could not single out the slaughterer (p_mimul_orpo_velo_orpo)
the mishna's oref is the oref itself
מנהני מילי? דתנו רבנן: ממול ערפו -- מול הרואה את העורף
וכן הוא אומר: והוא יושב ממלי -- mul means facing
מאי ואומר? וכי תימא: עורף גופיה לא ידעינן היכא, דנדע מול דידיה היכא -- facing the oref tells us nothing if we do not know where the oref is
'adjacent to its oref' -- facing the one who sees the oref
ומסתברא כמאן דאמר אף מחזיר, ממאי? מדקתני השוחט מן העורף שחיטתו פסולה, המולק מן העורף מליקתו כשרה
the mitzva of pinching: he turns the simanim behind the oref and pinches
